The open behavior is what happens to active report filters when the user switches workspaces. Today they carry over and can hide rows in the new workspace.

A) Reset to defaults: the filters return to the defaults owned by the resolver on every workspace switch.
B) Remember per workspace: each workspace restores its own last-used filters, and a new workspace starts from the defaults.
C) Prune what doesn't apply: filters carry over, but any filter that doesn't match the new workspace's data is dropped.
D) Other: name it.

Recommendation: A. It removes the hidden-row failure directly and keeps the resolver as the single source of defaults. It also adds no per-workspace state beside the resolver. B would only be worth it if users need their filters back when they return to a workspace.
